# Movavi

> > Movavi provides video editing, conversion, and screen recording software with AI-powered features for Windows and Mac users.

Movavi offers a comprehensive suite of multimedia tools including Movavi Video Editor, Movavi Video Converter, and free online conversion utilities. The platform supports extensive file format conversion (MP4, MOV, M4A, MP3, WAV, OGG, TIFF, JPG) with both desktop applications and web-based tools, featuring batch processing, AI upscaling, and automatic subtitle generation.
